comparison.objective: Candidate finishes threaded inserts by tang removal; record identifies an n-type (100) wafer by its flats and mounts it face-down on a dicing-tape chuck.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate uses impact tooling and fragment recovery; record requires visual discrimination, tweezer handling, edge-standing, handoff/regrasp, orientation, centering, and vacuum activation.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires four fractures, four contained tangs, retained inserts, and no damage; record requires the correct wafer centered with its primary flat aligned, face down, and vacuum on. No specs add thresholds.
comparison.reason: Although both demand precision, wafer identification/reorientation and vacuum mounting do not test fracture, impact regulation, or fragment containment.
